log_bump_latest.definition: CREATE TRIGGER log_bump_latest AFTER INSERT ON log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION log_bump_latest()

updates_bump_latest.definition: CREATE TRIGGER updates_bump_latest AFTER UPDATE OF selected ON updates FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION updates_bump_latest()

chain_insert_middle.definition: CREATE TRIGGER chain_insert_middle AFTER INSERT ON chain_start FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION chain_insert_middle()

chain_update_final.definition: CREATE TRIGGER chain_update_final AFTER INSERT ON chain_middle FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION chain_update_final()

cycle_update_middle.definition: CREATE TRIGGER cycle_update_middle AFTER UPDATE ON cycle_start FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cycle_update_middle()

cycle_update_start.definition: CREATE TRIGGER cycle_update_start AFTER UPDATE ON cycle_middle FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cycle_update_start()

unused_log_bump.definition: CREATE TRIGGER unused_log_bump AFTER INSERT ON unused_log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION unused_log_bump()

broken_log_bump.definition: CREATE TRIGGER broken_log_bump AFTER INSERT ON broken_log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION broken_log_bump()

conditional_log_bump.definition: CREATE TRIGGER conditional_log_bump AFTER INSERT ON conditional_log FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.r_id IS NOT NULL) EXECUTE FUNCTION conditional_log_bump()

log_bump_latest().definition: CREATE FUNCTION log_bump_latest() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE r SET latest = NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.r_id; RETURN NEW; END $$;

updates_bump_latest().definition: CREATE FUNCTION updates_bump_latest() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE r SET latest = NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.r_id; RETURN NEW; END $$;

chain_insert_middle().definition: CREATE FUNCTION chain_insert_middle() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO chain_middle (id, r_id) VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.r_id); RETURN NEW; END $$;

chain_update_final().definition: CREATE FUNCTION chain_update_final() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE chain_final SET latest = NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.r_id; RETURN NEW; END $$;

cycle_update_middle().definition: CREATE FUNCTION cycle_update_middle() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE cycle_middle SET latest = NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.r_id; RETURN NEW; END $$;

cycle_update_start().definition: CREATE FUNCTION cycle_update_start() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE cycle_start SET latest = NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.r_id; RETURN NEW; END $$;

unused_log_bump().definition: CREATE FUNCTION unused_log_bump() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE unused_r SET latest = NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.r_id; RETURN NEW; END $$;

broken_log_bump().definition: CREATE FUNCTION broken_log_bump() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN EXECUTE dynamic_statement; RETURN NEW; END $$;

conditional_log_bump().definition: CREATE FUNCTION conditional_log_bump() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE conditional_r SET latest = NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.r_id; RETURN NEW; END $$;
